original.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 adds a `{{- ... }}` notation for shallow (one-time) variable substitution, letting a policy substitute rule data (e.g. an HCL string defined in a ConfigMap) without Kyverno attempting to resolve the nested `{{ }}` variables inside it.

decision.reason: [ev-cc61618a6c99] describes an opt-in addition: nested substitution remains the default, and shallow substitution only happens where a policy author writes the new `{{- ... }}` notation (e.g. `{{- hcl }}`). The proposed exposure flags every environment that uses a ClusterPolicy or Policy, which is far broader than the state the change touches; nothing happens to an operator who does nothing. The evidence names no environment state that is exposed. It also does not say whether existing policies that already contain `{{-` are read differently, so no narrower condition can be asserted and applicability should stay undetermined. The CRD diffs (e.g. [ev-e0408f021210]) concern apiCall.default, an unrelated change.
